draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.69, the 215th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 16th of 21 at S. He went 224th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: vertical jump (94th percentile), broad jump (84th percentile). Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (16th percentile). College production: 63 tackles in 2020, 5th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.
